author: ABMN Staff
title: Investment Analysts’ Price Target Changes for January, 3rd (AAPL, BEZ, BME, BNP, COST, CS, HLAG, HNR1, MEURV, NESN)
text:
Investment Analysts’ price target changes for Thursday, January 3rd:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $185.00 target price by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $140.00 target price by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $180.00 target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Beazley (LON:BEZ) had its price target cut by UBS Group AG from GBX 580 ($7.58) to GBX 550 ($7.19). UBS Group AG currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
B&M European Value Retail (LON:BME) had its target price reduced by Peel Hunt from GBX 500 ($6.53) to GBX 450 ($5.88). They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
BNP Paribas (EPA:BNP) was given a €46.00 ($53.49) target price by analysts at HSBC Holdings plc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Costain Group (LON:COST) had its target price cut by Peel Hunt from GBX 500 ($6.53) to GBX 450 ($5.88). Peel Hunt currently has a buy rating on the stock.
AXA (EPA:CS) was given a €28.20 ($32.79) price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Hapag-Lloyd (ETR:HLAG) was given a €23.80 ($27.67) target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Hannover Re (FRA:HNR1) was given a €115.00 ($133.72) price target by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Munchener Ruckvers (AMS:MEURV) was given a €170.00 ($197.67) price target by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
Nestlé (VTX:NESN) was given a CHF 90 target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Quiz (LON:QUIZ) had its price target cut by Peel Hunt from GBX 40 ($0.52) to GBX 32 ($0.42). Peel Hunt currently has a hold rating on the stock.
Swiss Re (VTX:SREN) was given a CHF 78 target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
